author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex
statement: Under the PR 17 rational crossing contract plus a polynomial-bit computable certificate covering all odd bad primes through the call-size cap, a deterministic polynomial-size set of good primes and signed CRT recover every original integer query with polynomial overhead. The nilpotently conjugated polynomial-height adapted-basis families have such certificates. The general PR 17 contract remains randomized; no better rho, alpha, or polynomial-space bound is claimed.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the conditional all-size argument and prime certificate
A uniform cheaper crossing family with both rank bounds and a valid compact certificate
A deterministic transfer under the full unrestricted PR 17 denominator contract
